Name: JUST OK (NEXT DAY)
Author: carrotbbat
Description:
[b]Short Description[/b]
Simple Auto OK solutions: Choose between [b]JUST OK[/b] (Instant) or [b]JUST NEXT DAY[/b] (Custom Delay).
[line]
[b]Full Description[/b]
[b]Overview[/b] This project offers two versions of auto-clicker mods to solve the "AFK timeout" issue in multiplayer, especially when using the [b]ALWAYS ON SERVER MOD[/b]. You can choose the one that best fits your needs.
[b]Option 1: JUST OK (The Instant Version)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Concept:[/b] Clicks the OK button immediately.[/*]
[*][b]Best for:[/b] Dedicated servers or "Always On" hosts where you don't need to see the results.[/*]
[*][b]Features:[/b] Extremely lightweight, no settings required. It just works.[/*]
[/list][b]Option 2: JUST NEXT DAY (The Customizable Version)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Concept:[/b] Clicks the OK button after a delay set by the user.[/*]
[*][b]Best for:[/b] Players and hosts who want to check their daily profits before moving to the next day.[/*]
[*][b]Features:[/b] Includes a [b]Wait Timer (0-300s)[/b] and an [b]Enable/Disable[/b] toggle via the GMCM settings menu.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]What it does[/b] The logic is simple: [b]It clicks "OK" so the session stays alive.[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Next Day & Shipping Screen:[/b] Prevents the 5-minute idle kick in multiplayer by proceeding automatically.[/*]
[*][b]Event Choices:[/b] Automatically handles dialogue and event prompts.[/*]
[*][b]Universal OK:[/b] Detects and clicks almost any standard "OK" button in the game UI.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (Highly recommended for JUST NEXT DAY)[/*]
[/list][b]한국어 요약[/b]
이 프로젝트는 두 가지 버전의 모드를 제공합니다. 본인의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 모드를 선택하여 설치하세요.
[list=1]
[*][b]JUST OK:[/b] 정산 창이 뜨자마자 [b]즉시[/b] OK 버튼을 누릅니다. 서버 전용 PC나 빠른 진행을 원할 때 적합합니다.[/*]
[*][b]JUST NEXT DAY:[/b] 사용자가 설정한 [b]대기 시간(초)[/b] 뒤에 자동으로 OK 버튼을 누릅니다. 정산 내역을 확인하고 싶을 때 적합하며, 인게임 설정에서 딜레이를 조절할 수 있습니다.[/*]
[/list]
